1362.1001.1.description:
Test checks L2 multicast behaviour when an IGMPv2 Join is sent and then multicast packets are forwarded.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies L2 snooped IPv4 multicast forwarding driven by group membership. Sends an IGMPv2 join for the group, confirms the DUT records the membership in its snooping/mroute state, then transmits a matching multicast stream and confirms every packet is forwarded only to the joined receiver port and never leaks to other ports. Saves and restores the running-config and checks it is unchanged, and confirms no exceptions are logged on the stack members.
